h: Popular Benue dancer 'Benue Chris Brown' reportedly killed by suspected robbers
p: Dancer and entertainer Kelvin Ngutor, popularly known as Benue Chris Brown, has reportedly been killed by suspected armed robbers in Makurdi. Colleagues and fans are mourning him.
body: The Benue entertainment industry is mourning popular dancer and entertainer Kelvin Ngutor, known as Benue Chris Brown, who was reportedly killed by suspected armed robbers in Makurdi, the state capital.

Ngutor was reportedly attacked on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, by suspected robbers who allegedly took his motorcycle. A former aide to Governor Hyacinth Alia, Terver Atu, who announced the incident on social media, alleged that the attackers had been waiting for him at the entrance of an estate.
Colleagues and admirers have been remembering the young entertainer for his talent, passion and determination to build a career in entertainment.
No statement from the police about the incident was included in the reports.
more: He was known as Benue Chris Brown.
Suspected robbers reportedly took his motorcycle.
No police statement has been reported.
